question: Who takes down the tournament?
description: Resolves to the role of the tournament winner, based on their player profile.

question: Will a first-time player win it all?
description: Some of the deepest runs in past tournaments came from first-time players. Resolves YES if the winner has never played this tournament before.

question: Which table loses a player first?
description: Resolves to the starting table of the first player to bust.

question: Will someone from OpenOcean, Insight or AWS make the final table?
description: Resolves YES if at least one player from a host firm sits at the final table. Resolved by the organisers.

question: Will the final hand be played before 23:00?
description: Helsinki time. Resolved by the organisers when the winner is crowned.
